definitions: Used to emphasize that a statement is absolutely true or that something is a perfect example of its kind.
An intensifier, indicating that the preceding description is highly accurate or extreme.
examples: That was a mistake, if there ever was one.
She's a true artist, if there ever was one.
It was a challenge, if there ever was one.
He's a character, if there ever was one.
synonyms: if ever there was a case
